method.native_fill: Stored filled In1.Cu GND SHAPE_POLY_SET, preserving antipad voids; no refill/edit in this audit
method.area: Native TransformShapeToPolygon/BooleanAdd/BooleanIntersection/BooleanSubtract; actual trace widths and fixed 0.50mm survey bands
method.centerline: Native Contains at segment midpoints; missing intervals joined through same-net through-via endpoints
method.gap_component_metric: Sum of absent-GND trace lengths connected at track/via endpoints; branches can overestimate one path. Component bboxes are XY extents, not field-solver results.
method.band_limitation: 0.50mm survey width is a repeatable geometric probe, not a derived return-current requirement.
method.own_via_probe: 0.42mm radius around each target-net 0.50mm via: nominal0.25mm copper radius +0.15mm plane clearance +0.02mm geometric margin. Small residual edge slivers are listed separately.

stackup.consequence: No verified dielectric separations, Er or 90ohm differential impedance. B.Cu is adjacent to mixed In2, not directly to In1 ground.

ground_fill.warning: Stored fractured polygons can encode holes as cutouts; OutlineCount is not proof that return paths are electrically adequate.

limitations: Native DRC/parity do not qualify impedance, edge rates, return-current distribution, crosstalk or USB eye/EMC.
Own non-ground via antipads necessarily remove In1 copper directly below the layer transition; nearby ground stitching and actual reference geometry must be assessed against verified stackup.
Coverage of In1 ground below B.Cu does not prove the adjacent mixed In2 reference is continuous or adequately decoupled.
